name: vscode-todo-highlight
description: highlight TODOs, FIXMEs, and any keywords, annotations...

todohighlight.isCaseSensitive.description: Specify whether the keywords are case sensitive or not

todohighlight.wholeWordMatch.markdownDescription: When enabled, plain-text keywords are only highlighted when they appear as whole words (e.g. `BUG:` will no longer match the `BUG:` inside `DEBUG:`). This can be overridden per keyword with the `wholeWord` property. Keywords that use a custom `regex` are not affected.

todohighlight.toggleURI.description: If the file path within the output channel is not clickable, set this to true to toggle the path patten between `<path>#<line>` and `<path>:<line>:<column>`

todohighlight.keywords.markdownDescription: An array of keywords, and their CSS to customise how they look. See all available properties in the [VSCode doc on DecorationRenderOptions](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#DecorationRenderOptions) section.

anyOf.$comment: text and regex are self defined. The selection of the other properties for autocompletion are the same as for todohighlight.keywords.

pattern.description: The RegEx pattern to use for matching instead of the text value. REMEMBER to escape any backslashes in your regexp (using \\ instead of single backslash).

border.description: The border style for the highlight, as a CSS string.

cursor.description: The style for the cursor shown over the highlight, as a CSS property.

isWholeLine.description: If true, then the whole line is highlighted, not just the matching text.

wholeWord.description: If true, this keyword is only highlighted when it appears as a whole word (e.g. `BUG:` will not match inside `DEBUG:`). Overrides the global `todohighlight.wholeWordMatch` setting for this keyword. Has no effect when a custom `regex` is supplied.

overviewRulerColor.description: The color of the ruler mark on the scroll bar.

diagnosticSeverity.description: If enabled, set the diagnostic severity in the problems view.

todohighlight.keywordsPattern.description: Specify keywords via RegExp instead of `todohighlight.keywords` one by one. NOTE that if this present, `todohighlight.keywords` will be ignored. REMEMBER to escapse any backslashes in your regexp (using \\ instead of single backslash).

todohighlight.defaultStyle.markdownDescription: Default style for all customized keywords. See all available properties in the [VSCode doc on DecorationRenderOptions](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/references/vscode-api#DecorationRenderOptions) section.
todohighlight.defaultStyle.$comment: The selection of properties for autocompletion are the same as for todohighlight.keywords.

backgroundColor.description: The background color for the highlight.

border.description: The border style for the highlight, as a CSS string.

cursor.description: The style for the cursor shown over the highlight, as a CSS property.

isWholeLine.description: If true, then the whole line is highlighted, not just the matching text.

overviewRulerColor.description: The color of the ruler mark on the scroll bar.

todohighlight.include.description: Glob patterns that defines the files to search for. Only include files you need, DO NOT USE `{**/*.*}` for both performance and to avoid binary files.

todohighlight.exclude.description: Glob pattern that defines files and folders to exclude while listing annotations.

todohighlight.enableDiagnostics.description: Enable creating entries in the problems view.

_braceExpansionOverrideNotes: CVE-2026-13149: DoS via exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups. Patch per major line: 1.1.16, 2.1.2+, 5.0.7+.
CVE-2026-14257: DoS via unbounded expansion length / OOM. Official patch is 5.0.8 (5.x line).
Cannot force brace-expansion@5 onto minimatch@3: v5 exports { expand } while minimatch@3 expects a default function. Brace globs would break at runtime.
Where used: 1.x via production minimatch@3 (shipped in the extension); 2.x via mocha (dev); 5.x via eslint/minimatch@10 (dev).
_fastUriOverrideNotes: Security pin for fast-uri (Dependabot alert #70 / CVE-2026-16221 / GHSA-v2hh-gcrm-f6hx).
Host confusion via literal backslash in URI authority; can desync allowlist checks vs Node WHATWG URL/fetch.
Vulnerable: >=3.0.0 <=3.1.3. Patched: 3.1.4 (also 4.1.1 / 2.4.3 for other majors - not used here).
Where used: webpack → schema-utils → ajv → fast-uri (devDependency build path only; not shipped in the VSIX).
Pin via overrides rather than waiting on Dependabot PR #131 so the reason stays documented in package.json.
_linkifyItSecurityNotes: Dependabot alerts #68 (CVE-2026-59887) and #66 (CVE-2026-48801) on linkify-it, plus #64 on markdown-it.
Those packages came only via vsce → markdown-it → linkify-it (publish tooling wrongly listed under dependencies on older releases).
They are no longer in package.json / package-lock.json after the v2.0.9 dependency tidy that removed vsce from dependencies.
No override is applied: linkify-it is absent from the tree, and forcing 5.0.2 would break markdown-it@12 if vsce were re-added.
Pushing the commits that removed vsce should auto-close alerts #64, #66, and #68 on GitHub.
_jsYamlOverrideNotes: Security pin for js-yaml (Dependabot alert #73 / CVE-2026-59869 / GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m).
YAML merge-key chains can force quadratic CPU consumption while parsing.
Where used: mocha → js-yaml (devDependency / test runner only; not shipped in the VSIX).
_serializeJavascriptOverrideNotes: Security pin for serialize-javascript (Dependabot alerts #50 / GHSA-5c6j-r48x-rmvq and #61 / CVE-2026-34043).
#50: RCE via unsanitized RegExp.flags and Date.prototype.toISOString() when serialized output is evaluated. Vulnerable <=7.0.2; patched 7.0.3.
#61: CPU exhaustion DoS via crafted array-like objects. Vulnerable >=5.0.0 <7.0.5; patched 7.0.5.
Pin to 7.0.7 to cover both. Mocha declares ^6.0.2; 7.x keeps the same default-export serialize() API.
Where used: mocha → serialize-javascript (devDependency / test runner only; not shipped in the VSIX).
